execution_identity.attestation_limit: The explicit canonical path, binary digest, and version output are provenance evidence, not cryptographic attestation.

limitations: The corpus is public and must not be described as hidden or sealed.
The artifacts are short sanitized synthetic reconstructions, not full browser reports or independently captured traces.
Expected labels are author-created synthetic judgments and have not yet been independently adjudicated.
TODO: commission a blinded independent oracle audit before using this corpus for release-grade quality claims.
Three repeated calls measure within-prompt stability but are not independent samples; Wilson intervals therefore use only the 30 unique cases.
The fixed three-model matrix contains two provider families and does not establish performance for other hosts, models, versions, or settings.
F-code classification measures diagnosis triage, not whether a proposed fix repairs a live application.
Host and model strings are provenance claims, not cryptographic attestation.
